head.title: Fire first, _then_ the recipe.
head.dek: {Count} recipes from the test kitchen this week, and the one move each depends on.

cards.name: Charred lime broth
cards.claim: The depth comes from a lime burnt black in a dry pan, not from stock.

media.alt: A bowl of amber broth from above, oil drifting on it, with two charred lime halves beside it.

cards.name: Blood orange, fennel
cards.claim: Cut the orange across, never into wedges, and the salt lands on every segment.

media.alt: A blood orange cut across, deep red segments and pale pith, with fennel fronds.

cards.label: median time from cold pan to table across our weeknight recipes.
cards.source: 64 recipes, timed in the test kitchen, 2026

cards.text: Burn the lime. Properly black. That is the whole trick.

cards.name: Black beans, slow
cards.claim: Salt the water at the start; the skins stay whole and the middles go creamy.

media.alt: Black beans in a red enamelled pot from above, with soured cream, coriander and a wooden spoon.

cards.name: Chilli oil, two ways
cards.claim: Pour the oil at 120 °C and the flakes toast without turning bitter.

media.alt: A glass jar of red chilli oil with flakes settled at the bottom and a plain paper label.

end.title: All 64 recipes
end.note: Sorted by time, then by pan
